passkey.title: Approval passkey
passkey.intro: Approvals on real ACC are signed with a passkey (Windows Hello). Register at least one on this computer.

passkey.stepUpSteps: First confirm with an already registered passkey; then register the new one.
passkey.label: Passkey name
passkey.notInFixtures: In fixtures mode approvals are demo approvals and need no passkey.

errors.cancelled: You cancelled the Windows Hello prompt. Nothing was approved; you can try again.
errors.timeout: The confirmation timed out. Nothing was approved; try again.
errors.no_passkey: No passkeys are registered. Go to Settings → Passkey and register one with the code from npm run coordinator -- passkey-enroll.
errors.already_registered: This passkey is already registered on this computer.
